# LocalGPT for LLMs

LocalGPT is a .NET 9 Blazor/ASP.NET Core application hosted inside a WinUI 3 WebView2 Windows wrapper. It uses DevExpress Blazor components, Ollama-hosted AI models, configuration-driven AI profile selection, and backend services for native command execution and Minecraft mod workspace automation.

Main projects:

- LocalGPTWebviewWrapper/LocalGPT: ASP.NET Core host, Blazor UI, DevExpress components, AI services, setup/configuration pages.
- LocalGPTWebviewWrapper/LocalGPTWebviewWrapper: WinUI 3 and WebView2 desktop shell.
- LocalGPTWebviewWrapper/LocalGPTWebviewWrapper (Package): MSIX/DesktopBridge package project for deploy/debug.
- LocalGPTWebviewWrapper/build: repair/build scripts for local Windows development.

Key architecture:

- the WinUI wrapper should stay thin
- Blazor/server code owns AI, configuration, and command orchestration
- DevExpress static assets require LocalGPT.staticwebassets.runtime.json in the packaged executable folder
- native commands should flow through backend services such as INativeCommandRunner

Important assumptions:

- Visual Studio MSBuild is required for full package validation
- .NET 9 is the current target
- DevExpress 25.1 packages are expected
- Ollama runs outside the app and is selected/configured through setup data
- preferred Ollama debug model is gpt-oss:20b
- run LocalGPTWebviewWrapper/build/Test-OllamaGptOss.ps1 before debugging DxAIChat
